name: campaign_integrate
description: Fail-soft merge of successful feature-campaign wave branches; conflicts and failed tasks are returned to the WAIT checkpoint.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the integration git checkout that successful wave branches are merged into.

results.description: Wave subtask results, keyed by dynamic task reference name (or as a list, which is treated as index-keyed). Each value is either the subtask output directly, or a wrapper object with an 'output' key containing it.

integrated.description: True only when there were no merge failures and no conflicts.

merged.description: Branches merged cleanly with no conflicts.

completedTaskIds.description: Task IDs whose branch merged successfully.

failedTaskIds.description: Task IDs that did not report success, or whose merge conflicted.

conflicts.description: Merge conflicts encountered, aborted before returning.

sessions.description: Map of task ID to session ID, for resuming a matching subtask in a later wave.

totalTokens.description: Total LLM tokens summed across all subtask results in this wave.

totalCostUsd.description: Total USD cost summed across all subtask results in this wave, rounded to 6 decimals.

error.description: Present only if an unexpected exception occurred; integration is fail-soft and still returns partial merge/conflict state.
